title: 第3章 班级里的社交恐怖分子
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
一年三班的教室在三楼走廊尽头。

    苏念念推开门的时候，里面已经坐了十来个人。

    崭新的桌椅整整齐齐排列着，窗户开着，初秋的风裹着操场上隐约的喧闹声吹进来。

    苏念念的目光在教室里扫了一圈，精准地锁定了第四排靠窗的两个相邻座位。

    “这儿，我提前看过座位表了。”

    安槐跟着她走过去，把书包放在靠里面的位置，苏念念坐外面，理由很充分。

    “我个子矮，坐里面被你挡着看不见黑板。”

    安槐坐下来，长腿在课桌底下屈着，勉强找了个舒服的姿势。

    刚坐稳，后排就传来一个清脆的女声。

    “你好你好！我叫周小鱼！你叫什么名字呀？”

    安槐微微侧头。

    说话的是个圆脸短发的姑娘，眼睛又大又圆，像只好奇的松鼠，正趴在桌子上朝这边张望。

    不过她看的不是安槐，是苏念念。

    苏念念回头，眼睛一亮。

    好家伙，安槐心里暗道，来了。

    苏念念这个人有个绝活，她能在三十秒内跟一个陌生人变成朋友，三分钟内掏出对方祖上三代的信息，十分钟后两人就能好得像认识了十年。

    社交恐怖分子，名不虚传。

    “我叫苏念念！你也是三班的？你看起来好可爱啊！你家住哪儿？你淬体几重了？你喜欢吃什么？”

    周小鱼被这连珠炮般的问题砸得一愣一愣的，但很快也兴奋起来。

    “我家住城南的！淬体三重！我喜欢吃辣的！你呢你呢？”

    “我也喜欢！那你吃过南街那家麻辣烫没有？”

    “吃过吃过！他们家的牛肉丸子特别好吃！”

    “对对对！还有他们家的手工面！”

    安槐坐在前面，默默掏出一本参考书翻开。

    三十秒。

    准时。

    五分钟后，苏念念和周小鱼已经交换了联系方式，互相翻完了对方手机里的收藏夹，发现了三个共同关注的博主，还约好了周末一起去吃那家麻辣烫。

    安槐全程没有抬头，翻了三页书。

    【检测到教室内情绪密度上升。分析结果：“苏念念”和“周小鱼”的快乐情绪正在以指数级增长，再这么聊下去，今天的情绪值我直接提前完成KPI。】

    安槐翻了一页书。

    “嗯。”

    【你能不能有点反应？跟块石头似的。】

    “我在看书。”

    【你看的那本书你上辈子就背完了，你装什么呢，装货。】

    安槐嘴角微微一弯，没反驳。

    这时候，苏念念忽然拍了一下他的肩膀。

    “安槐，来，跟小鱼认识一下，她是我们后桌。”
content_en:
The classroom for the third grade of the first year is at the end of the corridor on the third floor.

When Su Niannian opened the door, there were already about ten people sitting inside.

Brand new tables and chairs were neatly arranged, the windows were open, and the early autumn wind blew in with the faint noise of the playground.

Su Niannian's eyes swept around the classroom and accurately targeted the two adjacent seats in the fourth row by the window.

"Here, I've read the seating chart in advance."

An Huai followed her and placed her schoolbag on the inside. Su Niannian sat outside for a very good reason.

"I'm short, so I can't see the blackboard because you're blocking me from sitting inside."

An Huai sat down, flexing her long legs under the desk, and managed to find a comfortable position.

As soon as I sat down, a clear female voice came from the back row.

"Hello, hello! My name is Zhou Xiaoyu! What's your name?"

An Huai tilted his head slightly.

The speaker was a girl with a round face and short hair, her eyes were big and round, like a curious squirrel, she was lying on the table looking over here.

But what she was looking at was not An Huai, but Su Niannian.

Su Niannian turned around and her eyes lit up.

Good guy, An Huai thought to himself, here he comes.

Su Niannian has a unique skill. She can become a friend with a stranger in thirty seconds. She can retrieve information about three generations of the other person's ancestors in three minutes. In ten minutes, the two of them can feel as if they have known each other for ten years.

Social terrorist, well-deserved reputation.

"My name is Su Niannian! Are you in Class 3 too? You look so cute! Where do you live? How heavy is your Tempering Body? What do you like to eat?"

Zhou Xiaoyu was stunned by the barrage of questions, but he soon became excited.

"I live in the south of the city! Third level of body tempering! I like spicy food! What about you?"

"I like it too! Have you tried the spicy hotpot on South Street?"

“I’ve eaten it before! Their beef meatballs are particularly delicious!”

"Yes, yes! And their handmade noodles!"

An Huai sat in front and silently took out a reference book and opened it.

Thirty seconds.

on time.

Five minutes later, Su Niannian and Zhou Xiaoyu had exchanged contact information, browsed through each other's favorites on each other's phones, found three bloggers they both followed, and made an appointment to go to that Malatang restaurant together on the weekend.

An Huai didn't look up the whole time and turned three pages of the book.

[An increase in emotional density in the classroom has been detected.Analysis results: The happiness of "Su Niannian" and "Zhou Xiaoyu" is increasing exponentially. If we continue chatting like this, today's emotional value will allow me to complete the KPI ahead of schedule.】

An Huai turned a page of the book.

"Yeah."

[Can you have some reaction?Like a stone.】

"I'm reading a book."

[You have memorized the book you are reading in your last life. What are you pretending to be? Loading it.】

An Huai's mouth curved slightly and he did not refute.

At this time, Su Niannian suddenly patted his shoulder.

"An Huai, come on, let's get to know Xiaoyu, she is our back desk."
title_en: Chapter 3 Social Terrorists in the Class
